title: Battle of Ambur
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ambur", at revision 1378418870, opens: "The Battle of Ambur was the first major battle of the Second Carnatic War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870289, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1749 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
